name: NEXT25 Professional Referral Network™
audiences: Executive coaches / career-transition professionals where appropriate
principle: Professionals should be able to introduce NEXT25 as a complementary life-transition discovery service without implying that NEXT25 replaces their tax, legal, investment or other professional advice.

referralModes: Professional landing page / co-branded education where approved

workflow: Professional registers or receives approved referral code
Consent is captured before linking professional to client record
Referral source stored separately from assessment answers
NEXT25 does not disclose Blueprint or personal responses back to referrer without explicit client authorization
Optional status can be limited to invited/enrolled/completed if client has consented
guardrails: No referral compensation unless separately reviewed for applicable professional, securities, insurance, legal, tax and state/federal rules.
No sharing of client Blueprint, assessment answers or sensitive information merely because a professional referred the client.
No claims that the professional endorses a specific NEXT25 recommendation.
Referral source must never alter matching/ranking or Blueprint content.
Marketing language should make NEXT25 complementary, not a substitute for regulated professional advice.
